title: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from search on mobile
summary: The briefing matches Microsoft's rollout notice and the roadmap, including automatic enablement and no required administrator action. The Teams app path and PowerShell control are documented; the briefing appropriately leaves the search entry's specific controls and eligibility unresolved.

claims.claim: Microsoft Teams mobile adds two ways to start a Copilot conversation from search on iOS and Android.
claims.quote: Users can now start a Copilot conversation directly from Teams search on iOS and Android. Microsoft Teams mobile is adding two ways to ask Copilot from search:

claims.quote: As users type two or more words in the search box, a suggestion to ask Copilot appears alongside usual search suggestions.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > app > Allow or Block controls the tenant-level Copilot app state.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Teams admin center and access Teams apps > Manage apps. Select the app on the Manage apps page and select Allow or Block option.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams PowerShell provides Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app-id> -IsBlocked <Boolean> to change the app state.
claims.quote: This cmdlet updates app state and app available values for the Microsoft Teams app. Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <String> [-IsBlocked <Boolean>]

claims.where: controls[0].note; Scope; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Teams Administrator is the documented role for using the Teams admin center.
claims.quote: To use Teams admin center, you must have a Teams Administrator role. Some admins with a higher privilege role can accomplish agent and app governance tasks

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Copilot Chat in Teams is managed through the Copilot app in the Teams admin center.
claims.quote: You can manage Copilot Chat in Teams through the Copilot app in the Teams admin center.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: One Copilot app is managed for all users regardless of licence.
claims.quote: As with other Teams apps, a single Copilot app is managed for all users, regardless of license.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Integrated Apps blocking is tenant-wide, can be scoped to users or groups, and blocks Copilot in its app, Teams, Outlook and web Chat.
claims.quote: Blocking Copilot through Integrated Apps is a tenant-wide control that you can scope to specific users or groups, including licensed users. This setting blocks Copilot in the Microsoft Copilot app, Teams, Outlook, and Copilot Chat on the web for all users.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified whether the Teams app setting or Integrated Apps block hides the mobile search suggestion and button.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Teams" "Ask Copilot" "search" "block" Integrated Apps admin control'. Opened manage-copilot-chat and manage-apps; MC1523087 says existing controls apply, but none specifies whether the search entry disappears.

claims.where: controls[1]; Governance controls table; Governance controls; Open questions
